summary.bn: সামনে কিছু এলে OUT LOW হয়; ট্রিমার ঠিক করে কতদূর পর্যন্ত দেখবে।
summary.en: OUT goes LOW while something is in front of it; the trimmer sets how far it sees.

simplified: It sees whatever is within the trimmer's range, from 2 cm to 30 cm (REPORTED, against a white wall). A real one sees by how much light comes back, which also depends on the surface's shine and angle.
A dark surface is seen only within half the range. That half is an estimate: sources say only that darker surfaces are seen nearer.
Sunlight and bright lamps, which can confuse a real one, are not modelled.
Its comparator switches cleanly. A real one can flicker near the edge of its range.
What it draws, about 20 mA from 5 V (REPORTED), is one resistance, so it draws less on 3.3 V.
The pins are in the order OUT, GND, VCC, as on the common FC-51 board. Some boards put them the other way: go by what is printed on yours.
